hooks.command:
jq -c '(.cwd // "") as $cwd
| (.tool_input.command // "") as $full
| ($cwd | gsub("(?<c>[^[:alnum:]_/-])"; "\\" + .c)) as $dir
| (if $cwd == "" then $full else ($full | sub("^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+[\"\u0027]?" + $dir + "[\"\u0027]?[[:space:]]*(;|&&)[[:space:]]*"; "")) end) as $rest
| ($rest | split("<<")[0] // "" | gsub("\"[^\"]*\"|\u0027[^\u0027]*\u0027"; "\"\"")) as $head
| "(^|[;&|(\n])[[:space:]]*" as $at
| "Instead of npx, node -e or python3, use npm run lint -- --fix, npm run format, npm run typecheck, npm run e2e -- <file> -g \"<name>\", npm test -- --coverage.enabled=false <path> or npm run design:check -- -g \"design: <screen>\"." as $npm
| [
    [$at + "cd([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not cd: you start in the workspace, so give paths instead."],
    [$at + "cat[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]", "Do not use cat: read a file with Read."],
    [$at + "grep([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use grep: search with git grep \"<pattern>\" -- \":!plans\"."],
    [$at + "head([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use head: read a file with Read, which takes an offset and a limit."],
    [$at + "ls([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use ls: list files with git ls-files -co --exclude-standard \"<glob>\"."],
    [$at + "sed([[:space:]]|$)", "Do not use sed: read a file with Read and change it with Edit."],
    [$at + "for[[:space:]]", "Do not use a for loop: run one command per Bash call."],
    [$at + "(npx|python3)([[:space:]]|$)", $npm],
    [$at + "node[[:space:]]+(-e|-p|--eval|--print)([[:space:]]|$)", $npm]
  ] as $table
| (first($table[] | . as [$re, $msg] | select($head | test($re)) | $msg) // null) as $why
| if $why != null then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: $why}}
  elif $rest != $full then
    {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", updatedInput: (.tool_input + {command: $rest}), additionalContext: "Dropped a leading cd into the workspace: you already run there."}}
  else empty end'
